children: NEW YORK, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Standard Motor Products, Inc. (
), a leading automotive parts manufacturer and distributor, is scheduled to report its earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, before the market opens on October 30, 2026.
Standard Motor Products, Inc. will hold a conference call at 11:00 AM, Eastern Time, on Friday, October 30, 2026.  This call will be webcast and can be accessed on our website at

Earnings Webcast link.  Investors may also listen to the call by dialing 800-347-6865 (domestic) or 203-518-9757 (international).  The conference call ID code is SMP3Q2026.  Our playback will be made available for dial in immediately following the call.  For those choosing to listen to the replay by webcast, the link should be active on our website within 24 hours after the call.  The playback number is 800-757-4761 (domestic) or 402-220-7215 (international).
